package.name: Texturizer
package.description: Surface textures for printed parts, based on BumpMesh by Stefan Hermann (CNC Kitchen): a part written as one closed mesh face by face, with a mask of the faces to texture, and the textured mesh checked against the part face by face (depth, faces it leaked onto, closed or not). A Python API (texturizer.mesh); tools for agents through Agent Link for FreeCAD when it is installed. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the FreeCAD project or the FPA.
